# Tiny Paws Haven 7

> Tiny Paws Haven 7 is a small, home-based cat fostering initiative in Tirana, Albania, run by two people (Davide and his partner). They take in stray kittens, get them healthy, and help each one find a family. It is not a shelter or a registered association.

## What we do
- Foster stray kittens in our own home in Tirana until they are healthy and ready.
- Get each kitten checked, dewormed, and cared for.
- Match each kitten, without rushing, with the right family.
- There is no fee, no form, and no waiting list. Adoption starts with a message on Instagram.

## Kittens
- Looking for a home now: see the current kittens on the "The Cats" page.
- Happy tails (already adopted): e.g. Cinnamon, a female kitten found alone near a café in Tirana, now adopted.

## Main pages
- Home: who we are and the kittens who need a home.
- The Cats: kittens currently in foster, with their story and health.
- Happy Tails: kittens who found a family.
- How Adoption Works: the simple, honest steps to adopt.
- About Us: who we are and why we foster.
- Say Hello: how to reach us.

## Contact
Instagram: @tinypawshaven7 (https://www.instagram.com/tinypawshaven7/). Direct message us to meet a kitten or ask a question. Based in Tirana, Albania. Site available in English and Albanian.
